description.value: The Aroma Bistro & Bar is an Indian restaurant in Abbotsford serving a wide-ranging menu of South Asian dishes — from tandoori specialties and butter chicken to Indo-Chinese fusion and daily thali specials. The restaurant styles itself as a community destination combining bold regional flavours with a welcoming, sit-down atmosphere. Online ordering and a reservations system make it accessible for both quick stops and longer meals.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (6 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active Indian restaurant at 32760 Simon Ave, Abbotsford. The OSM phone (+1-604-857-9011) appears on the /locations subpage alongside a second number (604-743-3131) that appears on most other pages — this discrepancy is flagged. The menu shows extensive vegetarian options and the site has an 'Order Online' link confirming takeout; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-604-857-9011, which appears on the /locations page, but most website pages (front page, /reservations, /cart) display a different number, (604)-743-3131. Two separate numbers may be listed for the same location, or one may be outdated.
Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'The Aroma Bistro' but the website consistently uses 'The Aroma Bistro & Bar'.
OSM cuisine tag is 'regional' but the menu is clearly Indian / Indo-Chinese cuisine.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Indian restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and broad menu — useful stop for touring cyclists in Abbotsford.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes numerous vegetarian dishes: Malai Soya Chaap, Vegetable Pakoda, Paneer Pakora, Chilli Paneer, Vegetable Fried Rice, Veggie Noodles, Paneer Special Thali, and more

wow_evidence: community destination combining bold regional flavours with a welcoming, sit-down atmosphere

price.signal: Menu mains $12–22; thalis $19–22. Casual sit-down Indian.
